metadata.title: A dimension-free bound for isoperimetry of unconditional log-concave measures
metadata.abstract: We prove a dimension-free Poincaré inequality for isotropic unconditional log-concave probability measures, establishing the Kannan-Lovász-Simonovits (KLS) conjecture in the unconditional setting. The proof combines a new application of Dunkl operator theory combined with an appropriate transformation of the log-concave measure. Specifically, the proof follows by a direct spectral analysis of a new Dunkl-Langevin operator adapted to the transformed measure. The core ideas of the proof were generated by AI generative tools through interactions with the authors over several weeks. The authors refined and formalized the argument.

analysis.topic: 度量测度几何、极限与奇异空间
analysis.progressType: 无条件对数凹测度的 KLS 界
analysis.workSummary: 对各向同性无条件对数凹测度给出维数无关的 Poincaré 界。证明用逐坐标 1-Lipschitz 输运将问题化到重加权测度，再以 Dunkl–Langevin 算子建立谱隙二择一估计，选取尺度排除坏分支；核心路线与证明草图的 AI 来源在正文单列披露。
analysis.breakthrough: 若论证成立，将解决无条件对数凹类的 KLS 猜想。
analysis.limitations: 主定理仅针对无条件测度；文中粗略常数约为 10¹²，C≤8 只是初步 AI 辅助计算提示的优化方向，并非已证明的常数。
analysis.aiEvidence: 作者披露模型在数周共同探索后独立建议 Dunkl–Langevin 新路线，并在随后四天互动中形成完整证明草图；作者再用数周核验、完善和简化。另提及 AI 辅助的初步常数优化计算，未将该优化列为已证结论。
